audio_source_description: Choose whether Filly records from your microphone only, or also mixes in system audio — useful in telemedicine calls where the patient's voice plays back as system audio.
filly_backend_unavailable: The Filly service is not available. Verify that the care_filly BE plugin is enabled in CARE and try again.
filly_disabled_note: Enable to use AI-assisted transcription on consultation forms.
filly_enabled_note: The Filly button will appear on consultation forms.
filly_profile_section_description: Record consultations and let AI fill clinical forms for you. Enabling requires accepting the terms and conditions.
microphone_description: Choose which microphone Filly should record from.
microphone_permission_required: Allow microphone access in your browser to choose a device.
no_permission_filly: You do not have permission to use Filly on this facility.
reset_filly_position_description: If you've dragged the Filly button somewhere inconvenient (e.g. over a page's Submit button), reset it back to its default corner.
system_audio_unavailable: System audio could not be captured — continuing with the microphone only.
